data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Create synthetic regression fixtures based on the empirical PR data from the story and write pytest tests that assert the ≥60% design target. Tests must fail with the current description-prefix matcher (they should pass after T4).

## Files to create

### Fixture files (synthetic JSONL)
- tests/fixtures/pr-102-cycle-1-defenses.jsonl — ~28 defense records, each with cited_lines matching the story's empirical data: merge-to-main-pr.sh:416, :422, :1073; sprint-story-review.yml:47; test-merge-to-main-pr-resume-and-stale.sh:147, :153, :175
- tests/fixtures/pr-102-cycle-2-findings.jsonl — ~19 findings with cited_lines near (within ±9 of) cycle-1 defense lines
- tests/fixtures/pr-103-cycle-2-defenses.jsonl — ~33 defense records with cited_lines: runner.py:941, test-ci-defense-pipeline.sh:1, review-defense-store.sh:569
- tests/fixtures/pr-103-cycle-3-findings.jsonl — ~17 findings with ~70% within ±5 lines of cycle-2 defense cited_lines

### Test file
- tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_suppress_regression.py (new)

## Test Structure
test_pr102_replay_meets_60pct_design_target: load fixtures, call _suppress_defended_findings with cycle-1 defenses against cycle-2 findings, assert >= 60% of findings downgraded to 'suggestion'
test_pr103_replay_meets_60pct_design_target: same for PR-103 data

## Acceptance
- All 4 fixture files exist with valid JSONL (each line is a valid JSON object)
- Fixture defenses include cited_lines field (list of 'file:line' strings)
- Tests exist in test_suppress_regression.py and currently FAIL (0% downgraded because description-prefix fallback won't match rephrased descriptions)
- ≥60% threshold is a design target assertion, not an empirical historical claim

## Implementation note
Use different descriptions in fixture findings vs defenses (rephrased text) to ensure current description-prefix matching fails, confirming the RED state.
